# CadenceCONNECT: Simulation Conference Japan 2026


14 Oct 2026


• 2 minute read


-
-
-
-


*Explore the Latest Simulation Technologies, Real-World Applications, and Digital Engineering Strategies for the Physical AI Era*


As products become more sophisticated and complex, engineering teams face growing pressure to accelerate development, improve product quality, and advance sustainability. Simulation, AI, and digital engineering are playing an increasingly important role in addressing these challenges and shaping the future of product development.


Against this backdrop, **CadenceCONNECT: Simulation Conference Japan 2026** will bring together engineers and R&D professionals on Thursday, November 5, in Toranomon and Osaka satellite venues. One of Japan's largest CAE user conferences, the event will showcase the latest simulation technologies, real-world applications of computer-aided engineering (CAE), and digital engineering strategies across industries, including automotive, aerospace and defense, electronics, and industrial machinery.


Through keynote presentations, user talks from leading companies and research institutions, technology exhibitions, and networking opportunities, attendees can gain practical insights into evolving engineering workflows and explore approaches to addressing increasingly complex product development challenges.


[Register for CadenceCONNECT: Simulation Conference Japan 2026](https://events.cadence.com/event/9efc54e0-594a-4700-aaf6-e166bfd1dd4e/home?environment=P2&utm_campaign=cc_jp_2026&utm_medium=web&utm_source=c_site)


## Explore the Latest Advances in Simulation and Digital Engineering


Following the acquisition of BETA CAE Systems in 2024 and MSC Software and Software Cradle in 2026, Cadence has significantly expanded its portfolio for physical system simulation. CadenceCONNECT: Simulation Conference Japan 2026 will showcase technologies across the Cadence Simulation portfolio, including:


-


Cadence MSC Nastran finite element analysis (FEA)


-


Cadence BETA CAE ANSA and BETA CAE META pre-processing and post-processing for simulation workflows


-


Cadence Fidelity CFD Software for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation


The conference will also explore emerging approaches to next-generation product development, including AI-powered simulation and digital engineering. These technologies are helping engineering teams address complex design challenges and improve development efficiency.


## Learn from Industry Experts and Connect with Peers


The program will feature keynote presentations and user talks from leading companies and research institutions, offering insights into real-world CAE applications and engineering challenges. Exhibitions by Cadence and its partners will provide opportunities to explore relevant technologies and solutions.


Attendees can connect with engineers and R&D professionals across industries, exchange experiences, and discover new perspectives on applying simulation technologies to product development.


## Join Us in Tokyo or Osaka


As product development evolves in the physical AI era, simulation, AI, and digital engineering are becoming increasingly important to achieving faster development cycles and higher-quality products. CadenceCONNECT: Simulation Conference Japan 2026 offers an opportunity to explore the technologies, practical experiences, and engineering expertise supporting this evolution.
